BiblicalUsage: In due season is the word for the goat sent away at the right time. In Leviticus 16:21 Aaron lays both his hands on the head of the live goat, confesses over him all the iniquities of Israel, and sends him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the fit man matters: the sins are carried away on time, by the hand appointed for it, into a land not inhabited.
